**About the Role** 




 We’re looking for a hands\-on Applied AI Engineer to build the AI tools, agents, and automations that make Ignitium faster, and increasingly, to build custom AI solutions and PoCs for our clients.
 



 This is a true individual contributor role in a complex environment. Our work spans dozens of interconnected systems: workflow platforms (n8n, Clay, Zapier, Make), data and BI tools (BQ, CloudSQL, Domo, Google Sheets), project management (Asana), enrichment and outbound tools (Outreach,
 
 Ora.im
 
 ,
 
 Apollo.io
 
 , Zoominfo, SalesLoft, Sales Navigator), intent data (Bombora, 6sense, Demandbase), ad platforms (LinkedIn, Meta, Google, Reddit, X), and a growing AI layer of Agents, MCP servers, custom skills, and browser automation. No two clients look alike and the problems are rarely well\-defined when they reach you.
 



 AI\-assisted development: We expect you to use AI coding tools aggressively. They’re core to how we work. AI assistance multiplies engineering skill, it doesn’t replace it. You must be able to read, debug, and own what you ship.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Internal AI Tools \& Automations (core of the role)** 



* Design, build, and maintain AI\-powered tools, agents, and workflows used daily by internal teams.
* Build integrations across our stack: n8n workflows with custom code, MCP servers, APIs, webhooks, and browser automation for systems without APIs.
* Translate ambiguous business problems into solutions with clear inputs, outputs, and success metrics.
* Harden what you build: error handling, logging, monitoring, and graceful failure for unattended workflows.



**Client\-Facing PoCs \& Custom Builds** 



* Build custom AI solutions, demos, and PoCs for client needs, adapting internal patterns to client data and systems.
* Prototype rapidly, evaluate against real data, and iterate.
* Document PoCs and support hand\-off into productionized implementations.



**AI Platform \& Best Practices** 



* Work fluently with LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI) and agentic tooling (Agent SDKs, MCP, skills).
* Apply best practices for context design, model selection, evaluation, guardrails, and data handling.
* Contribute reusable components and patterns so every build makes the next one faster.



**Collaboration** 



* Partner with non\-technical stakeholders to surface pain points worth automating.
* Explain trade\-offs (cost, latency, accuracy, reliability) in plain language.

**Engineering Fundamentals (non\-negotiable)** 



* Strong coding competency in
 **TypeScript/JavaScript and/or Python** 
 . You can build, debug, and maintain real software without an AI assistant, even though you’ll rarely work without one.

* Multiple internal AI tools shipped, actively used, and trusted, with stakeholders able to point to hours saved or quality gains.

**Overview:** 




  





 TekWissen is a global workforce management provider headquartered in Ann Arbor, Michigan that offers strategic talent solutions to our clients world\-wide. The below job opportunity is to one of Our clients is an American telecommunications company headquartered in Monroe, Louisiana, that offers communications, network services, security, cloud solutions, voice, and managed services.
 



  





  





**Description:** 




  





 Client is looking for an AI Engineer to design, build and run the agents that automate work across our digital commerce and transformation programs. The role is hands\-on and product\-minded: you take a business workflow, decide where an agent genuinely helps, and deliver a governed agent that people use every day. The work is built primarily on Microsoft's AI platform, spanning Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot Studio and the Microsoft 365 and Teams surfaces where our teams already work.
 



  





 This is a production engineering role rather than a prototyping one. Agents you build are expected to clear the Client Agentic Framework bar before they reach users: registered in the Agent Registry, authenticated through Microsoft Entra, authorized under least\-privilege RBAC, instrumented for observability, and certified through evaluation testing. You own that path end to end, from the first system prompt and tool schema through deployment, monitoring and iteration.
 



  





 You will work alongside program managers, data engineers, BI developers, solution architects and security partners, and you will spend as much time defining what good looks like as writing code. Strong candidates are comfortable with ambiguity, opinionated about evaluation, and able to explain in plain language what an agent can do, what it cannot, and how they know.
 



  





**What We Look For in a Candidate** 



* Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, data science or a related technical field, or equivalent hands\-on experience.
* Four or more years of software engineering experience, including at least one year building LLM\-based or agent\-based applications that reached production users.
* Strong Python skills, with C\# or TypeScript an advantage, and fluency with asynchronous APIs, REST and GraphQL, JSON schemas and Git\-based workflows.
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft AI services, including Azure AI Foundry or Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, and at least one of Copilot Studio, Semantic Kernel or the Microsoft Agent Framework.
* Practical retrieval\-augmented generation experience covering chunking strategy, embeddings, vector search, reranking and retrieval evaluation.
* Working knowledge of Model Context Protocol or comparable tool\-calling and function\-calling patterns, including schema design and versioning.
* Demonstrated skill in prompt and context engineering, including system prompts, few\-shot design and model\-specific behavior.
* Experience evaluating LLM systems with offline and online methods, regression suites and human review loops, and a clear point of view on what is worth measuring.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID, OAuth2 and JWT, role\-based access control and API gateway patterns.
* Experience with CI/CD, containers, infrastructure as code and observability tooling such as Azure Monitor, Application Insights and OpenTelemetry.
* Clear written communication, including the ability to explain agent behavior, limits and failure modes to partners who are not engineers.
* Sound judgment about where an agent is the right answer, and the willingness to say plainly when it is not.



**Also valuable:** 



* Microsoft certification such as Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI\-102\) or an Azure architecture credential.
* Experience with Power Platform, including Power Automate and Dataverse, or with Microsoft Fabric and Power BI.
* Telecommunications, order management, billing or business\-to\-business commerce domain experience.
* Contributions to agent platform tooling, registries, evaluation frameworks or internal developer experience.
